ORAL ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioners and respondent No.2 in W.P.No.33488/2019 and respondent No.3 in W.P.Nos.18410/2022 and 18411/2022 submit in unison that the parties have amicably settled their dispute in terms of the joint affidavits filed before the Court.

2. The joint affidavit in W.P.No.33488/2019 reads as under:
"We, 1) Mr.Sushil Pandurang Mantri s/o Pandurang Mantri aged about 62 years 2)
Mrs.Snehal Mantri w/o Sushil Pandurang Mantri aged about 61 years both are at No.5-1, C/5, Rich Homes, Richmond Road, Richmond Town, Bengaluru - 560025,
the petitioner.
2) Mr. Rakesh V.S. S/o. Sri Surendra Babu V., aged about 42 years,
residing at Door No.14, NRN Residency, Flat 5, 9th Cross, Kamkya Layout, BSK 3rd Stage, Bengaluru - 560 085.

The 2nd respondent, do hereby jointly affirm and state the oath as follows:
1.

We swear that the present petition is filed by the petitioners seeking quashing of the FIR in Crime NC: 2025:KHC:805 No.144/2019 and dated 28/07/2019 filed by the first respondent Cubbon Park Police Station upon receipt of complaint by the 2nd respondent.
Interim order was granted by this Hon'ble Court pending the disposal of main petition, staying all further proceedings in the said crime number.
2. We swear that grievance of the complainant was that the petitioner company has received amount for apartment and failed to deliver the apartment or refund the money.

Now, the 2nd respondent and the petitioners have entered into a cancellation agreement dated 12.11.2024 seeking cancellation of sale agreement and received refund of amount o/ Rs.8,99,576/- by way of settlement amount on 18/08/2023 vide UTR No.NRTGS/PUNBR52023081818061184 / RAKESH Vs. whereby the dispute in the above detailed FIR has been resolved in its entirety.

A copy of Cancellation agreement dated 12.11.2024 is herewith produced at Hon'ble Court as Document No.1.

6. The joint affidavits and the submissions are placed on record.

7. Heard Sri M.S.Shyam Sundar, learned Senior Advocate for Smt.Vandana P.L., the learned counsel for the - 14 - NC: 2025:KHC:805 petitioners, Smt.Rashmi Jadhav, learned Additional SPP, Smt.Jaithra J.
Narayan and Sri Rohit R. Kamath, learned counsels for the respondents. Perused the records.
8.
The petitioners and respondent No.2/respondent No.3 admit the contents of the joint affidavits.

9. It is brought to the notice of this Court that similar petitions filed in W.P.No.15240/2021 connected with W.P.No.12911/2022 are also settled and the petitions are allowed vide order dated 19.12.2024.
10.
In view of the above, I deem it appropriate to quash the FIRs as the dispute is amicably settled.
